g.text: Deterministic 3-Way Reconciliation Core with Bounded AI Intelligence & Human-in-the-Loop Governance
Multi-Source Financial Ingestion & Integer Cent Normalization
SOURCE OF TRUTH • ZERO AI ARITHMETIC
Exact ID match on order_id / txn_reference
Rule 1: Exact Key Pairing (O(1) Hash Map)
• T+1 / T+2 settlement calendar window check
✓ Strict Separation of Matches vs Exceptions
Deterministic Root Cause Analysis, Hypotheses & Priority Ranking
• Distinguishes Fee Deductions vs True Leakage
• Exposure formula: Dollar Value × Aging Factor
• Dynamic SLA tracking (P1, P2, P3, P4)
• Immediate triage of high-risk balance leaks
Deterministic System passes read-only verified context (context_builder.py). AI never queries raw unverified ledgers.
Strict Enforced Hierarchy: Code Determines Financial Facts ➔ AI Explains & Recommends ➔ Human Approves Actions
Human Financial Analyst (Final Decision Control Point)
Web Command Center: Investigation.tsx & Cases.tsx with interactive evidence inspection
All material financial state transitions require user attribution.
No transaction record or event entry is ever mutated or deleted.
✓ Compliant with statutory fintech financial reconciliation standards
• 100+ Transaction Batch with calibrated real-world anomalies
• Injects: fee deductions, bank delays, duplicate webhooks, missing payouts
Deterministic Engine evaluates predictions vs known ground-truth labels
Why ExceptionOS beats traditional reconciliation bots:
• Many tools force 100% match rates by hallucinating matches or masking mismatches.
• ExceptionOS explicitly flags genuinely ambiguous cases as UNRESOLVED.
• Surfaces edge cases directly to human analysts with hypotheses rather than auto-resolving.
✓ Eliminates hidden balance sheet errors and regulatory fines.
ARCHITECTURAL MANDATE: Deterministic systems establish financial truth. Bounded AI provides verified operational intelligence. Humans retain sovereign decision governance.
